name: Xerneas
normal: dark grey-navy body (about 40% of pixels), blue markings, pale blue-white antlers and legs
desc: pale antlers and legs turn blue, blue markings lighten to azure; dark body cannot be lightened by rules
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured pixel by pixel. Blue markings (h262, L0.52, C0.143, 22%) go to h228, L0.74, C0.130 (cs 0.9, ls 1.4; window narrowed to 10 so the h245-255 antler edge is not caught). Pale antlers/legs (h230-240, L0.81, C0.045, about 19%) go to h258, L0.52, C0.13, so a 230>258 rule with chroma x3 and light x0.65 was added; the old grey-only tint kept them pale. Grey tint hue moved 250 to 258. The dark body (L0.42, C0.012, 40%) turns near-white L0.82; hue rules need C>=0.04 and grey rules cannot change lightness, so it is not modeled. Sim OKLab error vs shiny sprite 0.287 -> 0.221.

shiny: cream-yellow belly and head, blue back unchanged, yellow eye pattern
desc: white body turns cream yellow, cyan eye pattern turns yellow, back stays blue
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)

Cyan eye is only h225-235 (L0.69, C0.115) and goes to h93, L0.79; window narrowed to 229+-8 because the blue back starts at h250 and the 12-wide window plus 12 feather reached it. Blue back (h254) unchanged. Sim error 0.0376 -> 0.0293.

desc: green fur turns yellow-green (h110), belly goes paler, brown ears turn red-pink
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/<name> (HOME normal vs shiny sprites, per-pixel OKLCh comparison; Bulbapedia 403)
note: Re-measured. Fur (h125-135, 45%, L0.83, C0.161) goes to h110, L0.89, C0.135. Belly (h100-110, 14%, C0.128) goes to C0.04-0.06 at about the same hue (cs 0.4). Fur rule listed last so it wins overlaps. Sim error 0.0195 -> 0.0098.
